policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: senators press on Hugging Face breach
items.summary: AP reports bipartisan senators questioned O about the Hugging Face incident and requested details after a January probe letter. While oversight context, the public scrutiny increases reputational/regulatory risk for O.

items.headline: O: publishes Hugging Face incident report
items.summary: O published its technical post on the Hugging Face incident, describing internal cybersecurity evaluation failures, security gaps, and corrective actions (sandboxing, access control, safeguards, monitoring).

items.headline: O: adds AI safety official to board
items.summary: Credible press reports O appointed an AI safety official to its board. Governance changes can affect oversight intensity and risk management posture.

items.headline: G: valuation tracker updates to latest funding
items.summary: DefiLlama updated its pre-IPO valuation metrics after the August 2026 Series A. Useful as corroborating market-facing valuation context (not primary evidence).

items.headline: V: W-5 mission page confirms reentry details
items.summary: V’s W-5 mission page documents launch/reentry timeline and frames W-5 as the first reentry of its next-generation satellite bus intended for routine high-cadence operations.

items.headline: V: PR release on W-5 reentry success
items.summary: PR Newswire reprinted V’s announcement of W-5 reentry success and vertically integrated satellite bus debut—useful for tracking third-party distribution of the company release.

items.headline: G: $350M Series A at $3.5B valuation
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive (planned NVIDIA participation), valuing G at $3.5B. It also projects scaling from 54MW to 200+MW in 2027.
